title: Arivium Pixelmon
description: Arivium - A custom adventure map. Battle it out against Team Eclipse as you journey around the Arivium region! Features include custom spawns, a unique storyline, side-quests, and a whole lot of detail. (Pixelmon 1.16.5)
body:
Arivium - A custom Pixelmon adventure map. Battle it out against Team Eclipse as you journey around the Arivium region! Encounter custom spawns, play through a unique storyline, juggle side-quests, and peruse through a whole lot of detail!
Throughout the Arivium region are various skills that you can dabble in and master. These skills can provide useful items and Pokemon to guide you along in your journey, so make sure to make use of them! Keep an eye out for unusual looking Arivian Pokemon that inhabit this region as well as they may prove to be of aid.
Features
  - 🌟 Skills System - Skills system consisting of Crafting, Cooking, Herbalism, Mining, Fishing, and Raiding - 🏃 Side Quests - Side quests throughout the region that vary in difficulty and award many different things between money, items, and Pokemon - 🥊 EV Training Sites - Various EV training sites are available throughout different skill areas - ‼️ Custom Forms - Exclusive Arivian forms with custom typings and unique movesets - 🏅 Gym Challenge - Region-specific Pokemon gyms - 4️⃣ Elite 4 Challenge - Region-specific Elite 4 - 🦹 Villain Team - Story-specific villain team to face off against
